name: DailyBeat — Google-free
description: DailyBeat's independently maintained repository for its Google-free Android build. This is not the official F-Droid repository or an endorsement by F-Droid. Journal journeys, places and notes locally. Online maps are on by default; optional cloud AI is off by default. This build uses Android platform location and does not include the developer's managed cloud-backup configuration. Source and licence: https://github.com/sampathmannam/dailybeat (GPL-3.0-only).
